segments.text: Feliss is originally a 6th Class Devil, currently binded by contract with Rance. Ever since meeting the latter, she experienced misfortunes and was demoted several times. Mainly providing service in battlefield and in bed, she also serves as Rance's personal informant and as events occur, provides important information that would otherwise be unbeknownst to him.
From AliceSoft Wiki
悪魔（階級は、第7級魔神）です。
本来なら人類がもっとも恐れる存在であるが、ランスに真の名を知られた事により、
ランスの命令には絶対に逆らえない状況にされている。ほとんどランスの使い魔として便利に扱われている。
それも呼び出されては、何をするでなくセックスの相手をさせられるだけだっりして哀れな事このうえない。
カラー時代、ちょっと不良娘だったため悪魔となった。
根は真面目だったので悪魔の仕事も誠実にこなし第六階級まで駆け上がったが、ランスに出会ったことで坂を転がるように人生を転落させていった。
mask原本为卡拉，因为学坏而/mask在22岁时成为恶魔。

在《II》中，菲莉丝偶然被兰斯以“恶魔契约”召唤，mask以死后付出灵魂为契约（Deal with the Devil）代价要兰斯许下三个愿望，结果兰斯许了两次愿望之后，第三次愿望以“让整个契约无效”，结果让菲莉丝没办法与兰斯完成契约而被从六级恶魔贬为九级，并被分派为‘恶魔洞窟’的门卫，遇上前来洞穴寻找物件的兰斯。第一次将兰斯赶跑，第二次由于兰斯事先已经得知她的本名，从此成为兰斯随时差遣与泄欲的使役魔。
在《5D》中，菲莉丝被兰斯在月事来的日子强奸，怀孕生下黑暗兰斯（ダークランス），因此触犯恶魔界禁律“与人类产子”，遭受生产300只恶魔与严刑拷问的惩罚，结果导致精神受创。脱逃之后，与儿子四处流浪。参 3后在《QUEST》中被兰斯接回兰斯城居住。/mask
ランスの使い魔。
ちょっと不良ちゃんだったので22歳の時に悪魔化した元カラーの女の子。
おふだを持ったランスに半ば偶然召喚された。悪魔のくせに人が良い上に騙されやすく、それも祟って悪魔界一不幸な悪魔。ちなみにランスが初契約成立の相手らしい。
ランスの願いをかなえたは良いが、騙されて契約を破棄された為に第6階級から第9階級に降格させられた。ランスが原因で本当に悲惨な目にあった数少ない例。
maskが、さすがにランスも、ランスクエスト・マグナムでの再会時は、フェリスに負い目を感じているようで、彼によってランス城地下に匿われた事で、何とか平穏な生活は送れている。ただし、導く者の騒動で、ランスとの間に生まれた息子であるダークランスとは生き別れ状態になっている。/mask

Athena 2.0 is an artificial humanoid lifeform part of the Athena Series, created by Frostvine using magic and the essence of a devil and an angel. She's basically an orange-haired organic magical android that serves as a pet to Rance, aiding him when adventuring and serving as some sort of watchdog for his house. She was originally created to be the ultimate toy for a child after the original, Athena 1.0, ended up being too human-like and ran off with a Ham Bambara monster.
From AliceSoft Wiki
魔女フロストバインが作った人工生命体。
構成されている材料に若干問題があったのか少し変？
人間に近づく為の実地研修という形でランスの元に預けられているが、
なんの成長もせずにランスとエッチしたり近所の子供と遊んだり
日々楽しそうに暮らしている。
大魔女フロストバインが生み出した
人工生命体あてなシリーズの第2号。
ランスに懐いておりペットのような存在。
今は自由都市アイスのランス宅でお留守番中。
魔女フロストバインによって生み出された究極の人工生命体……のはずが、材料にランスの精液が
混じったためか少々おつむが足りない。
失敗作なんかじゃないのれす

イラーピュに住んでいた魔女フロストバイン謹製の人工生命体。人間に可能なことは全て可能な万能ぶりを見せる。戦闘力が高くHもできるが、制作材料にランスの体液が混ざったため、設計と異なり頭が致命的に弱い。しかしながら、性格は素直かつ従順で、「ご主人様」であるランスのことが大好きである。また、日常生活において役には立たないが、冒険となると、非常に高い戦闘能力だけでなく寸分も狂わぬ正確なマッピング機能、電卓いらずの演算機能、暗闇も平気な望遠鏡のような等、色々と役に立ってくれる。また、あらゆる声真似も可能。試作品の運用テストということでランスに預けられる前にヴァージョンUPもしており、ランスの要望で乳首追加（あてなver2.01）ランスの要望でアソコ追加（あてなver2.02）
現在はランス家の居候で、普段はシィルの手伝いもせず近所の子供と遊んでいる。ムシ大好きでちょっとSMちっくな変態エロが好き。お酒では酔っぱらわないが、カキピーを食べると酔う。

Bird Lithfie is an adventurer with horrendous luck who has crossed paths with Rance far more times than he'd like to. He is a polite young man with a gentle face, giving him a kind and heroic appearance.
From AliceSoft Wiki
ごく真っ当で普通の戦士。
ランスと遭遇する事が多く不運になる事が多い。
きっとランスとさえ出会わなければ、いい人生を送っていただろうに…
片腕は切り落とされており、オプションの武器を装着可能。
ドリルとかハンマーとか磁石とか…うーん、役にたたねぇ

ランスと同じ冒険者の一人。仕事には真面目で、ルックスや育ちの良さなどからも、本来主人公でもおかしくないが、肝心の戦闘力に関してはランスに大きく劣っていて、いわゆるごく普通の戦士（行く先々でよく遭遇することから、それでも並の傭兵などよりは実力があると思われる）。純情で奥手ではあるが、非常に惚れっぽく、誰かを本気で好きになっても、すぐまた別の女性の女性を好きになってしまい、他の女のことなどあっさり忘れてしまう性質の悪い面があり、しかもバード自身に自覚が全く無い有様と、ある意味でランスよりも酷い女ったらしである。ランスのせいで酷い目にあうことが多いが、自身の性格や行動が原因となることもあるため、全面的にランスが悪い訳ではない。真知子によると、ヒーロー・シンドロームに陥っているらしい。

A fearsome warrior known throughout the land, not just for his impressive battle skills but also for his shameless womanizing ways. While he's driven more by his primal instincts than noble ideals, his actions often result in unexpected heroism.

Even though he's rough around the edges, Rance often ends up doing good deeds on his many adventures, even if he doesn't intend to. His exploits are varied, including battling fearsome demons, standing against rival nations, and even helping out those in distress.

Unironically, Rance's disorderly conduct frequently lands him in hot water. His relentless chase of carnal indulgences tends to create more facepalm moments than applaudable ones, adding to his already infamous reputation.

On his frequent adventures, Rance is not a lone wolf. He is often accompanied by a cast of unique characters who add their own spice to the narrative. However, these companions, notably his enslaved romantic interest Sill Plain among others, often find themselves grappling with his audacious behavior. Despite the hurdles, this diverse crew manages to unite their skills, forming a solid team crucial to their shared escapades.

Sill is a slave purchased by the great adventurer Rance in the year LP0001 prior to the events of Rance 01. Rance purchased her for 15,000 GOLD and has been forced to travel alongside him wherever he goes since then. However, Sill developed strong romantic feelings for him and, even though the "Absolute Obedience Magic" once cast on her has long since worn off, she remains single-mindedly loyal to Rance regardless. She was originally from a rich family in Zeth but under "certain circumstances" ended up in the slave market sold to Rance.

She is capable of using both offensive and healing magic, in addition to the creation of magic barriers. She is also known to have a large knowledge of worldly culture and history, as well as an understanding of many creatures. This is apparently due to her studying from a wide variety of books at a young age due to her origins from a noble family.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Genri is a rugged monk of the Tenshi Sect who has crossed paths with Rance multiple times. He is notorious for possessing a massive penis.

Genri is a muscular man with a scruffy, unshaven appearance. As a monk of the Tenshi Sect, his head is shaved, revealing a distinct scar across his scalp, and he wears standard Tenshi robes. Despite his appearance, he is actually quite young, and is only two years older than Rance.
From AliceSoft Wiki

The official mascot of Alice Soft. A polite young girl who often communicates with the player as a medium in some Alice Soft games. She sometimes represent marketing upcoming Alice Soft games in trailers and advertisements.
She is accompanied by her pet black crow named Yukichi.
Kisara Copley is a notoriously talented adventurer from the Free Cities Alliance that took well-paid jobs of any kind.

In the past, her parents ran a successful business on the Free Cities but through many misfortunes and deceptions from others, their company was soon left bankrupted and accumulated a massive debt over the years, reaching the absurd value of 4,000,000 GOLD. Filled with despair, her parents ended up hanging themselves and the debt was passed to their daughters. As a consequence for this, the creditors took Kisara's younger sister Rebecca Copley as payment, resulting in her becoming a Fukuman prostitute working for Pluepet. In order to pay the debt and free her sister from slavery, Kisara became an adventurer as means to acquire the financial support. However, despite being a fairly talented individual with solid fighting ability and skilled for adventuring, she found herself regularly deceived and tricked by those she trusted several times, resulting in her never being able to gather the money needed to pay the debt.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Pluepet is a talented merchant born in the free city of Portugal in GI980. He travels to all sorts of places as a travelling merchant selling rare goods. He appeared in most Rance games after the 4.x games, and also made appearances in Toushin Toshi games.

He's a strange green creature that travels around in something that resembles a spaceship. His race is unknown but he's probably some rare type of monster. Personality-wise, he's a businessman. He's a very skilled and clever individual that knows how to trade, but he's also very cruel and cold, showing no interest in everything outside of selling his goods and making money. He completely lacks morality and will do whatever he considers will bring the best earning, regardless if it's selling drugs, slaves or innocent girls as prostitutes. He simply sees everything around him as a means to trade and increase profits, and is perfectly fine with helping people as well if he thinks it will be profitable.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Doharas Happiness is the President and founder of Happiness Pharmaceutical and the creator of the universally-used healing medicine Seirogan. He lives in the main Happiness Pharmaceuticals factory building in the Free City of Ice with his young daughter Eline.
From AliceSoft Wiki

segments.text: Silbarrel Silbarella is an infamously ugly individual originally from the Free Cities Alliance. Her first appearance was in Rance 4.1, where she works as the chief of dorms in Happiness Pharmaceutical. Rance considers her his greatest foe, due to the great fear it inspires in him to just look at her.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Kontama is a pretty average employee that works in the Factory of the Happiness Pharmaceutical Company, not in the Drug Developments Laboratories, but in the manufacture and packaging sections in the factory.

Due to the attacks the company suffered from the monsters that came from a Dungeon below the Factory, the building was temporarily closed and sealed off. Kontama was one of the workers that remained in the building, as he was in charge of keeping an eye out to the Gate that sealed the entrance to the Monsters to prevent anyone from entering or monsters from leaving. He operated a machine to open the gate for the Adventurers hired by the company to exterminate the beasts, and they would ring a bell from the inside whenever they intended to come out, since said gate can only be opened by Kontama from his side.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Arnie Rolento is an adventurer that applied for the job presented by Happiness Pharmaceutical to exterminate the monsters in the dungeon below their Factory.

Arnie Rolento was the leader of the Bear Group Division of the Angel Army, the extremist Organization that fought for the rights of Monsters. Her division represented the offensive unit of the Organization, being the primal combat force specialized in taking down their enemies with frontal battles. She worships her boss and Leader of the Angel Army, Archibald, and follows all his orders with unquestionable devotion and loyalty.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Eline Happiness is the young daughter of Doharas Happiness, the President of international drug conglomerate Happiness Pharmaceutical. She lives with her father in the company's main factory building in the Free City of Ice.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Summon-chan is a Rare Gal Monster that works under Archibald for the extremist Monster Protectionists Group, the Angel Army. She's very loyal, dedicated and devoted to the group, especially to its leader, Archibald. Being of the Rare type, means she's the only Summon-chan Gal Monster in the world, an extremely rare one of a kind type that is only born once. Due to this, she has the unique and terrifying ability of summoning other monsters at will by using special magic of her own.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Conan Hokaben is the head of security at Happiness Pharmaceutical in the Free City of Ice.
From AliceSoft Wiki

The System Goddess is a goddess who has encountered Rance in his journeys, though it is unknown if his these meetings are canon or not. She is in charge of saving, loading, and changing system options in your game.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Rose is the Laboratory Manager of the Second Laboratory at Happiness Pharmaceutical, the company responsible for over 50% of the Continent's medicine production. Rose is an intelligent and intellectual woman, and is very dedicated to her medicinal research, which is aided by her skill levels in Medicine and Research. She has a quite timid personality due to a lack of self-confidence, stemming from chronic insecurity over her appearance. Despite her natural beauty, for some reason she believes herself to be plain and unattractive, and she is surprised and embarrassed when Rance lavishes her with compliments. She gets along well with her subordinates in the Second Laboratory as well as her boss, Doharas Happiness. She has a cordial relationship with Joseph, who secretly has a crush on her, and is one of the few people he respects.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Pink Mask is a female superhero in disguise, travelling around helping those in need and aiding adventurers that are in itchy situations. She made appearance only in the Rance 4.1 and Rance 4.2 games, where she first appeared in the dungeon infested with monsters below the Factory of the Happiness Pharmaceutical company. She mostly showed up in front of Rance, and assisted him in live or death situations, being somewhat of a Guardian Angel for him during his adventure in which he coincidentally didn't take Sill Plain with him, but Athena 2.0 instead.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Partie Burr is the leader of the Rabbit Group Division of the Angel Army, the extremist Organization that fought for the rights of Monsters. Her division was specialized in infiltration, espionage, sabotage and, sometimes, guerrilla operations and even terrorist attacks. She adores her boss and Leader of the Angel Army, Archibald, and is willing to do anything or go anywhere for him.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Joseph is the Laboratory Manager of the 1st Lab in the Offices of Happiness Pharmaceutical, the company responsible for the creation of several medicinal drugs and that currently holds 50% of the accounts for the whole market.

He became the manager of one of the main Labs of this monstruous company at the outstanding age of 13 years old, and was deemed as a genius boy with an amazing intellect. He's always been subject of praise and many claimed that he was fated for greatness and, upon becoming the Manager of the 1st Lab of the Company, he developed an overinflated ego that resulted in him becoming an incredibly obnoxious and unpleasant person. He's extremely arrogant and looks down on all his assistants, mocking their incompetence as he managed to become the Manager with his young age, while others that are in his forties work for him. The only people he respects are the President Doharas Happiness, who he holds great respect for due to his genius invention of the Seirogan, and the Manager of the 2nd Lab Rose, with who he developed a crush for and works hard to get her attention.
From AliceSoft Wiki
